notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hey! This is the first post-release patch that introduces new content. 

[list]
[*] Adds a new monument near the edge of Dreamer's Grounds that unlocks fast travel.
[*] Minor level and dialogue tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.12
notes.content:
More minor fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixes a rare crash that could occur after seeing the ending cutscene.
[*] In order for a grove to be marked as cleared, you now must reveal the monument in that grove if there is a monument. You may still exit groves with undiscovered monuments. The main consequence of this change is that upon reaching the exit of a grove win an undiscovered monument, the grove's position will not be saved and on restart, you will have the chance to play again from the start.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixes a rare crash that could occur after seeing the ending cutscene.

[*] In order for a grove to be marked as cleared, you now must reveal the monument in that grove if there is a monument. You may still exit groves with undiscovered monuments. The main consequence of this change is that upon reaching the exit of a grove win an undiscovered monument, the grove's position will not be saved and on restart, you will have the chance to play again from the start.

notes.title: Saturday, October 8th, 2022: v1.0.11
notes.content:
This release includes a handful of minor fixes:

[list]
[*] Tweaked the color tinting on a few chapters.
[*] Fixed a soft lock that could occur on The Gardener's Grounds VI.
[*] Slightly adjusted The Chromatic Grounds VII to allow for more player improvisation.
[*] Squiggle effect is no longer turned on by default.
[/list]

I hope you are enjoying the game :)

[/list]
